description.describe_ch: 本課程的目的在教導python語言,課程內容包含陣列與List,類別與物件,建構函式與繼承與例外處理,學生將被要求練習現場的課堂作業和定期程式作業。
description.describe_eh: The goal of this course is teach pyhon programming. The course subjects include Array and List, class and object. Contructor fnuction and exception handle.Students are required to do programming practice in class and take-home program assignments.

學生請假依本校學生請假辦法辦理,務必要在上课之前,檢附請假理由及文件,線上提出申請。若不在申請期限內完成請假作無者,無充 分的理由,經核准不得取消扣分。
 
2. 考評及補考 Assessment

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
My requirements for you are simple. Attendance is important. You will benefit from hearing the lecture, the questions of your fellow students, and information about upcoming assignments and exams. You are required to complete and submit all your assignments on time.

I expect you to complete the required readings MATLAB programming before coming to class. Attendance and participation are part of your grade.  You are also required to give at least one oral presentation. This counts for 10%. I will be taking roll at the start of each class and I'll keep track of participation. 
 
All weekly readings are due before you come to class. We will refer to the text frequently in class, especially during the discussion . Please bring the readings with you, either electronic or printed. Active participation in class discussions is very important. Come with questions and opinions on the readings.
 
Electronic devices are allowed in class only for reading and note-taking. class related activities such as texting, chatting, blogging, and web  surfing are prohibited. 

I want you to bring laptops and the reason for that is, not that I think you're going to be Facebooking or answering your email laptops in my experience  which is to talk to each other with c programing.
One of the things I want to emphasize is that attendance here in the electors is very much required.  I've asked the teaching assistant (TA) to take notes.  If you're missing a lot of lectures, it could affect your grade. So please come to the lectures.

Attendance, Which accounts for 15% of your grade is taken by “Mobile FCU”.  If you do not have a device capable of scanning “Mobile FCU” or forget to bring one to Class. Cards will be available for manual sign in. If you are discovered fraudulently signing in for an absent classmate, the penalty is a zero for this category.
All absences must be excused, which means they must meet one of two conditions: one the absence is excused by the university. Examples are school-sponsored events for competitions. You are able to produce documentation for the unforeseen circumstances that prevented your attendance. Notification email should come before the absence, except in the case of emergencies.

You are expected to attend all classes. Due to the size of this class, make-up assignments including examinations will be allowed only in exceptional cases, such as documented illness. Students who encounter such a situation must inform me by email immediately. The makeup assignments or exam will differ in format and content from what was administered to the rest of the students in class.

The course adheres  to the Feng Chia  University's rules on plagiarism. Any form of cheating will be immediately reported to the university. In course penalties will range from zero on the assignment to failing the course, depending on the severity of the violation.
